subject: The secret workflow mistake 99% of PupShape users make
preview_text: Our top 1% of users do this one thing differently. It's not what you think, and it changes everything.
body_paragraphs: I was reviewing the data for our most successful users—the ones whose dogs are hitting milestones like clockwork. And I noticed something that made me pause. They weren't just logging meals. They were using the app in a way I never explicitly told anyone about.

These power users treat PupShape like a command center, not a diary. They don't just react to their dog's day; they plan for it. Every Sunday night, they spend 5 minutes in the app setting up the entire week. They pre-log their dog's main meals based on the custom plan, block out their exercise sessions by breed type, and even schedule their treat allowances for training or fun. This turns weight loss from a daily guessing game into an automated, stress-free system. The relief is palpable—no more 9pm guilt over an extra biscuit.

This all happens in one place: the Weekly Planner. It's the feature tucked behind the calendar icon. Most people see it and think 'I'll get to it later.' But our top 1% start there. They use it to lock in their vet-approved nutrition guidelines for the week ahead, making every decision proactive instead of reactive.

Your action today: Open PupShape and tap the calendar icon. Spend 5 minutes plotting out just the next three days. See how it feels to be in control. P.S. The dogs following this method are 3x more likely to stay on track after a 'cheat day'—because the plan is already waiting for them tomorrow.
